correctness.rationale: The hull resolution is published and the two restriction splittings are reconstructed directly. For a smooth conic whose plane avoids the hull singular point, the restricted linear forms form the complete three-dimensional space of conic hyperplane sections, forcing the split type O(-1)^2 on P1 and a two-dimensional Hom space to the degree-minus-one quotient. For a line avoiding the singular point, the split type is O plus O(-1), yielding a one-dimensional Hom space. Automorphism quotients give respectively a P1 of kernels and a unique kernel. Parameter dimensions are 3+8+1=12 and 3+8=11. Stability, Chern classes, double dual, and purity are checked explicitly.
